verses.english: “Mendicants, a farmer has three primary duties.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, kassako gahapati paṭikacceva khettaṁ sukaṭṭhaṁ karoti sumatikataṁ.
verses.english: A farmer first of all makes sure the field is well ploughed and tilled.

verses.pali: Paṭikacceva khettaṁ sukaṭṭhaṁ karitvā sumatikataṁ kālena bījāni patiṭṭhāpeti.
verses.english: Next they plant seeds in season.

verses.pali: Kālena bījāni patiṭṭhāpetvā samayena udakaṁ abhinetipi apanetipi.
verses.english: When the time is right, they irrigate the field and then drain it.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi kassakassa gahapatissa pubbe karaṇīyāni.
verses.english: These are the three primary duties of a farmer.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, tīṇimāni bhikkhussa pubbe karaṇīyāni.
verses.english: In the same way, a mendicant has three primary duties.
Undertaking the training in the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom.

verses.pali: imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi bhikkhussa pubbe karaṇīyāni.
verses.english: These are the three primary duties of a mendicant.
So you should train like this:

verses.pali: ‘tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne’ti.
verses.english: ‘We will have keen enthusiasm for undertaking the training in the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom.’
